items.name: LC-39A
items.description: The historic pad that launched Apollo 11, later refitted for Falcon 9 crewed flights. Full crew-access infrastructure.

items.name: LC-39B
items.description: Kennedy Space Center's pad for the Space Launch System, purpose-built with mobile launcher and crew access arm for Artemis.

items.name: SLC-41
items.description: Cape Canaveral pad for the Atlas family. This is where Mars 2020 lifted off. No crew access arm.

items.name: SLC-40
items.description: Cape Canaveral pad dedicated to Falcon 9 cargo missions. Fastest and cheapest option, but no crew infrastructure.
